Initially unverified S04-finite-safe-change-allowlist: Delegation allows only appending required unverified scenarios with empty evidence, filling an empty verificationPlan with an exact already declared/preapproved command, and appending an exact command from the reviewed finite preapproved-command set. Original declarations and original order remain intact.

Initially unverified S05-real-scope-and-standard-boundaries: Scope changes, authority/risk/policy/reviewer/source changes, resource or operation expansion, acceptance changes, command replacement/removal, required-scenario downgrade/removal, arbitrary verification commands and protected status/evidence changes remain rejected or require the normal fresh human boundary.

Initially unverified S06-exact-native-bindings: Derive delegated review only from Runtime-validated canonical owner-review state and a fully valid amendment lineage, never a caller-selected arbitrary approval file. Bind repository/WI, approved baseline, before/after Contract, policy digest, request/change set, current snapshot, Runtime and exact agent/source. Preserve the existing local provenance assurance boundary.

Initially unverified S07-locked-atomic-history: Recheck source/bindings under the existing lifecycle lock before publishing review/amendment effects. Preserve expected-digest/CAS, full current/prospective journal validation, byte immutability, interruption evidence and no completion of unrelated pending operations.

Initially unverified S08-agent-is-not-human-and-legacy-bytes: Record delegated decisions as agent technical review with their real provenance. Never write or rewrite decisionEvidence/human review as if a person reviewed the new Contract. Old absent-policy Contracts and old receipt serialization/digests remain unchanged.

Initially unverified S09-cli-mcp-parity: CLI and MCP use the same typed initial scenario/delegation declarations and core amendment decision. Reuse existing start/amend/control transports; do not introduce extra MCP tools or alter tool-count/name assertions.

Initially unverified S10-real-bounded-development-flow: In a real isolated repository, after one explicit baseline owner review, ordinary in-scope development, a permitted required-scenario/command addition and a legitimate verification retry do not request an extra product human review. Nonzero tests actually execute; failures remain.

Initially unverified S11-scope-and-activation-isolation: Change only the declared 9 production, 4 test and 12 trilingual documentation paths plus own native records. Preserve WI1087 design/planning records and every prior WI evidence. The governing WI uses fixed b2 legacy strict mode and never the feature under development.

Initially unverified S12-quality-and-conditional-delivery: Pass the nine declared commands, meaningful selected tests, full workspace/package coverage, strict Clippy, formatting/docs/diff and independent whole-branch review. Preserve all RED/failure records.

Complete workflow scope is declared at entry: native controls/preflight/checkpoint, production-path RED→GREEN, declared validation, material/diff review, independent whole-branch review, ordinary commits, later explicitly authorized branch push/draft/PR binding/exactHEAD CI/normalmerge/main verification/recoverable exact resources/native finalization/true close/closeout publication. No external action or human decision is inferred from this technical implementation authorization.
Delivery includes the normal source/native branch/PR/CI/main/resource lifecycle only under separately applicable exact public/merge/close authorization.
